input.quote: any Party is entitled to make available any of its Allocated Capacity for use by other Carriers on any commercial basis without any restrictions.
input.rationale: No restrictive covenant binding us exists anywhere in the Agreement. Targeted searches for "compete"/"competing", "shall not engage in", "exclusiv", "prohibited from", "restrict" and field-of-use/territory language returned no non-compete: every "compete" hit is "Court of competent jurisdiction" or "competent tribunal" (p0272, p0275), and the only "exclusiv" hit is the dispute-resolution sole-and-exclusive-remedy clause (p0262). To the contrary, the capacity provisions affirm our commercial freedom — Paragraph 12.20 permits IRU sales to other Carriers "without any restrictions" and Paragraph 12.22 permits making Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "on any commercial basis without any restrictions" — and Subparagraph 17.4 binds Terminal Parties not to impede Direct Access, which benefits us. This sits at the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is proposed; the pro-competitive clauses above are in our favour and are not flagged.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
